verdict.rationale: uv is a local command-line Python package and project manager with no hosted service API, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no API surface such a spec could describe. The llms.txt documentation index and JSON-formatted CLI output are not API specifications and do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
